gifts.title: One page that finally answers 'how do you get business?'
gifts.for_complaint: Confusion about what they currently offer
gifts.deliverable: Single published page: current services (facials, microblading/brows, lashes, select hair) pulled straight off their live GlossGenius menu, real hours and phone from their public Google Business Profile, embedded map, and a direct Book Now link — the exact page a lost prospect needs, ready to link from their Google profile and Instagram bio today.
gifts.inputs_needed: Their live GlossGenius page (facialswithrachel.glossgenius.com — already loads, 200 OK, has services/prices), their public Google Business Profile hours/phone, a public map embed.
gifts.why_they_stop_and_read: It's their own customer's exact words, 'how do you get business,' answered — the one thing a stranger couldn't find is now one link away, and it cost them nothing.

gifts.title: A door sign so a locked door doesn't read as 'gone out of business'
gifts.for_complaint: Showed up and got no service, no warning
gifts.deliverable: Print-ready door sign (PDF/PNG, two sizes) with the real phone number and hours and a clear line: 'With a client right now — text [number] and I'll reply, or book at [real GlossGenius link].' Tapes to the same door the 3-star reviewer found locked.
gifts.inputs_needed: Real phone number and hours from their public Google Business Profile.
gifts.why_they_stop_and_read: It's the literal fix for the review that asked 'how do you get business' out loud — a $0 print job that turns a locked door from a dead end into a next step.

gifts.title: A QR card that lets people book instead of calling at 8:30am
gifts.for_complaint: No way to see real availability without calling
gifts.deliverable: Small printed card / social-bio link with a QR code straight to their live GlossGenius booking calendar, labeled 'See today's real openings — no call needed,' sized for the counter or door.
gifts.inputs_needed: The public GlossGenius booking URL (already confirmed live and reachable — no login required to view or book).
gifts.why_they_stop_and_read: It removes the exact failure in the 2017 review — call, get bad news, hang up and go elsewhere — by putting the real calendar in front of them instead of a phone that might not get picked up.
